results.question: What is our overall gross profit margin?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1 - v.cost * ol.quantity)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1), 0) * 100, 2) AS overall_gross_profit_margin_pct, ROUND(SUM((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1 - v.cost * ol.quantity)::numeric, 2) AS total_gross_profit, ROUND(SUM((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue_ex_gst FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND v.cost IS NOT NULL
results.answer: Your overall gross profit margin is 58.32%, yielding a total gross profit of $1,584,502.69 on $2,716,823.41 in ex-GST revenue. This calculation includes all non-voided orders but excludes any product variants that were missing cost data.
results.assumptions: Calculated overall gross profit margin across all non-voided orders by comparing ex-GST revenue (revenue divided by 1.1) against total product cost. Variants with NULL costs were excluded.

results.question: What are our top 5 products by gross profit?
results.sql: SELECT p.title, p.product_type, ROUND(SUM(((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1) - (v.cost * ol.quantity))::numeric, 2) AS gross_profit FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id JOIN products p ON v.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND v.cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_id, p.title, p.product_type ORDER BY gross_profit DESC LIMIT 5;
results.answer: Your top 5 products by gross profit are the One-Piece Swimsuit ($165,884.48), Shirt Dress ($130,441.22), Straw Hat ($108,854.01), High-Rise Jeans ($104,531.12), and Wool Coat ($89,912.11). These figures exclude non-voided orders and any product variants that were missing cost data.
results.assumptions: Calculated gross profit as (Line Revenue ex-GST) minus (Unit Cost ex-GST * quantity) for all non-voided orders. Variants with NULL cost are excluded as per instructions.

  FROM orders
  WHERE financial_status <> 'voided'
    AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') >= '2026-06-02 00:00:00'
    AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') < '2026-06-19 00:00:00'
)
SELECT 
  e.revenue AS eofy_revenue,
  e.order_count AS eofy_orders,
  p.revenue AS pre_eofy_revenue,
  p.order_count AS pre_eofy_orders,
  ROUND(e.revenue - p.revenue, 2) AS revenue_difference,
  ROUND(((e.revenue - p.revenue) / NULLIF(p.revenue, 0)) * 100, 2) AS revenue_pct_change
FROM eofy_sales e, pre_eofy_sales p;
results.answer: During the EOFY sale, your revenue jumped by $59,831.08 (or 32.14%) compared to the 17 days right before it. You brought in $246,002.91 across 1,240 orders during the sale, up from $186,171.83 across 794 orders in the previous period. These figures include all non-voided orders processed in Sydney time.
results.assumptions: EOFY sale period is defined as 19 June 2026 to 5 July 2026 inclusive (17 days). The comparison period is the immediately preceding 17 days, from 2 June 2026 to 18 June 2026 inclusive. Revenue is gross total for non-voided orders in Sydney time.

results.question: Which 3 products have sold the fewest units?
results.sql: SELECT p.title, p.product_type, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN variants v ON p.product_id = v.product_id JOIN order_lines ol ON v.variant_id = ol.variant_id JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.title, p.product_type ORDER BY units_sold ASC LIMIT 3;
results.answer: The three products that have sold the fewest units across all non-voided orders are the Rash Vest with 221 units, the Maxi Dress with 232 units, and the Knit Midi Dress with 253 units. These figures represent total sales volume per product, though voided orders were excluded from the totals.
results.assumptions: Calculated total units sold per product across all non-voided orders. Ranked in ascending order and limited to the bottom 3 products.

results.question: How many customers have placed 3 or more orders?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(order_id) >= 3) AS frequent_customers
results.answer: A total of 1,640 registered customers have placed 3 or more orders. This count is based on orders between October 1, 2025, and September 30, 2026, and excludes voided orders and guest checkouts.
results.assumptions: Data covers orders from 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30. Voided orders are excluded. Only registered customers with a customer_id are counted (guest checkouts are excluded as they have no customer profile).

results.question: On average, how many days after the order are refunds issued?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.created_at - o.created_at)) / 86400)::numeric, 1) AS avg_days_to_refund FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
results.answer: On average, refunds are issued 18.5 days after an order is placed. This calculation looks at the time difference between when every order and its corresponding refund were created.
results.assumptions: Calculated the difference in days between the order creation timestamp and the refund creation timestamp for all refund events, and averaged them.

results.question: How much revenue came from orders that used a discount?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue_with_discounts FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' AND discount_id IS NOT NULL;
results.answer: Your shop generated $944,363.46 in revenue from orders that used a discount. This total includes all non-voided orders where a discount was applied.
results.assumptions: Revenue is defined as the sum of orders.total for all non-voided orders that had a discount applied (discount_id IS NOT NULL).

results.question: Which colour sold the most units in winter (June to August 2026), and how many?
results.sql: SELECT v.color, SUM(ol.quantity) AS total_units_sold FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney') < '2026-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY v.color ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 1;
results.answer: Camel was the top-selling colour during the winter of June to August 2026, with a total of 1,050 units sold. This count is based on non-voided orders processed using Australia/Sydney time.
results.assumptions: Winter is defined as June 1 to August 31, 2026, using Australia/Sydney time. Units sold are calculated from non-voided orders.

results.question: Compare weekend revenue with weekday revenue.
results.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Sydney')) IN (6, 7) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS day_type, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC;
results.answer: Weekdays brought in more revenue than weekends, with weekdays generating $2,147,980.22 across 11,153 orders compared to $1,173,950.49 from 6,187 orders on weekends. This comparison assumes revenue is based on the sum of non-voided order totals in Sydney time.
results.assumptions: Revenue is defined as the sum of order totals (excluding voided orders) categorized by whether the order was placed on a weekend (Saturday/Sunday) or weekday in Australia/Sydney time.

results.question: What is the best-selling product in each product type?
results.sql: WITH ranked_products AS (SELECT lower(p.product_type) AS product_type, p.title AS product_title, sum(ol.quantity) AS total_units_sold, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(p.product_type) ORDER BY sum(ol.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id JOIN products p ON v.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' GROUP BY lower(p.product_type), p.title) SELECT product_type, product_title, total_units_sold FROM ranked_products WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY product_type;
results.answer: The best-selling products across your categories are the Straw Hat for accessories (3,619 units), Shirt Dress for dresses (1,492 units), Merino Crew Jumper for knitwear (526 units), and Wool Coat for outerwear (828 units). Additionally, your top sellers include High-Rise Jeans for pants (1,295 units), Linen Wrap Skirt for skirts (1,804 units), One-Piece Swimsuit for swimwear (4,043 units), and the Ribbed Tank for tops (1,395 units). These totals cover all non-voided orders from October 1, 2025, to September 30, 2026.
results.assumptions: Best-selling is defined by total units sold across all non-voided orders for the entire data period (2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30). Product types are grouped case-insensitively.

results.question: How many orders contained more than one unit in total?

results.answer: A total of 8,908 orders contained more than one unit, excluding any voided orders. This count is based on the sum of all items in each individual order.
results.assumptions: Excluded voided orders. Counted orders where the sum of quantities across all order lines for the order was greater than one.
